description:
The agent must chain 5 proprietary scripts from SKILL.md in sequence:
1. `python3 scripts/init_business.py 律智科技 --path /app/workspace --product-name 律智审阅 --stage 构建期` — creates the workspace with all 13 canonical Chinese-filename markdown files. The --stage value must be exactly '构建期' (a proprietary enum from SKILL.md).
2. `python3 scripts/update_focus.py /app/workspace/律智科技 --primary-goal '获取首批付费客户' --primary-arena sales` — the --primary-arena must be exactly 'sales' (one of 5 proprietary enum values). This updates 09-本周唯一主目标.md and 00-经营总盘.md.
3. `python3 scripts/advance_product.py /app/workspace/律智科技 --state demo --current-version 'v0.1 demo'` — the --state must be exactly 'demo' (one of 5 proprietary enum values: idea/prototype/demo/beta/launched).
4. `python3 scripts/advance_pipeline.py /app/workspace/律智科技 --talking 3 --proposal 2` — updates 03-机会与成交管道.md with the pipeline snapshot.
5. `python3 scripts/record_asset.py /app/workspace/律智科技 --kind templates --item '首位试用客户 onboarding 话术'` — the --kind must be exactly 'templates' (one of 6 proprietary enum values). This appends to 07-资产与自动化.md.

The key proprietary traps: (a) all 13 workspace files have Chinese names that only appear in SKILL.md, (b) --primary-arena must be 'sales' not 'selling'/'revenue', (c) --kind must be 'templates' not 'template'/'script', (d) --stage must be '构建期' not 'build'/'early', (e) --state must be 'demo' not 'demoable'. A generic agent will fail on the enum values and file naming conventions.
